name: Aleth
source:
Aleth is the fifth romance option in Lovewood. They are the travelling merchant who frequently stops by Liebwald and is a good friend of Kaileen.
Aleth has a curse that makes it impossible for them to speak out true statements, instead talking in a lie whenever they try. This curse was a result of an alchemy accident, and they get around it by speaking mainly through written text on a portable chalkboard, paraphrasing their sentences as questions, using sarcasm or using the occasional BSL sign as shorthand in conversations.

Aleth is the fifth romance option in Lovewood. They are the travelling merchant who frequently stops by Liebwald and is a good friend of Kaileen.
Aleth has a curse that makes it impossible for them to speak out true statements, instead talking in a lie whenever they try.
